messages:
Nina CSM: Heads-up — Cartel Logistics wants to add 4 product teams next quarter (Search, Returns, Pricing, Analytics). They estimate ~3x token volume and asked about Dedicated vs burst. Also hit 429s during sandbox tests.

Ethan AE: Nice expansion signal. Renewal in ~9 months. Do they want a timed pilot or go straight to reserved capacity?

Nina CSM: Prefer pilot first. They also need SSO + prod keys.

Maya Support: SUP-801 opened for 429s. Logs show concurrent spikes with no client-side backoff. Recommend jittered exponential backoff. KB: https://redwood.cloud/docs/rate-limits.

Ravi Eng: For sustained 3x, Dedicated recommended. Need workload split (embeddings vs gen), token lengths, and p95 latency targets. Can we get a sample trace?

Nina CSM: Sent sample: median 400 tokens, peaks ~1100, embeddings ~55% of tokens, normal peak ~1500 rpm, spike ~4200 rpm. DM'd to @Ravi Eng.

ops-bot: Capacity request CAP-4207 created: +3 GPU equiv, autoscale 07:00-21:00 UTC. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/capacity/CAP-4207

Ethan AE: I'll add a 2-week pilot clause and loop Finance for commit tiers.

Ravi Eng: I'll run a quick load sim with KV cache + batching and post results EOD.

Nina CSM: Thanks team — tracking as expansion-oppty in CRM, tagging SUP-801 & CAP-4207. I'll follow up with the customer for exact route splits.
